javascript_prelude: const pitrig = root['pitrig'] || (root['pitrig'] = {}); if (!pitrig.state) { pitrig.state = function (key) { const identity = $prop('DataCorePlugin.GameData.NewData.CarId') + '|' + $prop('DataCorePlugin.GameData.NewData.TrackId') + '|' + $prop('DataCorePlugin.GameData.NewData.SessionTypeName'); const laps = $prop('DataCorePlugin.GameData.NewData.CompletedLaps') || 0; let state = pitrig[key]; if (!state || state.identity !== identity || laps < state.laps) { state = { identity: identity }; pitrig[key] = state; } state.laps = laps; return state; }; }

session.lap.last_delta_best.javascript: if (!$prop('DataCorePlugin.GameRunning')) return null; const last = timespantoseconds($prop('DataCorePlugin.GameData.NewData.LastLapTime')); const best = timespantoseconds($prop('DataCorePlugin.GameData.NewData.BestLapTime')); const state = pitrig.state('lap.last_delta_best'); if (last > 0 && last !== state.last) { const reference = state.best === undefined ? best : state.best; state.result = reference > 0 ? (last - reference) * 1000 : null; state.last = last; } state.best = best; return state.result === undefined ? null : state.result;

session.lap.last_status.javascript: if (!$prop('DataCorePlugin.GameRunning')) return null; const last = timespantoseconds($prop('DataCorePlugin.GameData.NewData.LastLapTime')); const state = pitrig.state('lap.last_status'); const invalid = $prop('DataCorePlugin.GameData.NewData.LapInvalidated') === true; if (last > 0 && last !== state.last) { state.lastInvalid = state.last !== undefined && state.invalid === true; state.last = last; state.invalid = invalid; } else if (invalid) { state.invalid = true; } if (!(last > 0)) return 0; if (state.lastInvalid) return 4; const classLap = driverbestlap(isnull($prop('DataCorePlugin.GameData.NewData.BestLapOpponentSameClassPosition'), -1) + 1); const classBest = classLap ? timespantoseconds(classLap) : 0; const best = timespantoseconds($prop('DataCorePlugin.GameData.NewData.BestLapTime')); if (classBest > 0 && last <= classBest) return 3; if (!(best > 0) || last <= best) return 2; return 1;

session.sector.delta.javascript: if (!$prop('DataCorePlugin.GameRunning')) return null; const delta = $prop('PersistantTrackerPlugin.SessionBestLiveDeltaSeconds'); const state = pitrig.state('sector.delta'); const sector = $prop('DataCorePlugin.GameData.NewData.CurrentSectorIndex'); const best = timespantoseconds($prop('DataCorePlugin.GameData.NewData.BestLapTime')); if (delta === null || delta === undefined || !(best > 0) || delta < -0.2 * best) return null; const jumped = state.previous !== undefined && Math.abs(delta - state.previous) > 1; state.previous = delta; if (jumped || state.sector !== sector) { state.boundary = !jumped && state.sector !== undefined; state.sector = sector; state.start = sector === 1 ? 0 : delta; } return state.boundary || sector === 1 ? (delta - state.start) * 1000 : null;

session.checkered.javascript: if (!$prop('DataCorePlugin.GameRunning')) return null; const flag = $prop('DataCorePlugin.GameData.NewData.Flag_Checkered'); const state = pitrig.state('session.checkered'); if (flag > 0) state.shown = true; return state.shown === true;

tyre.{wheel}.pressure_average.javascript: if (!$prop('DataCorePlugin.GameRunning')) return null; const sample = $prop('DataCorePlugin.GameData.NewData.TyrePressure{suffix}'); const state = pitrig.state('average.TyrePressure{suffix}'); const inPit = $prop('DataCorePlugin.GameData.NewData.IsInPitLane') > 0 || $prop('DataCorePlugin.GameData.NewData.IsInPit') > 0; if (!state.samples || (state.inPit && !inPit)) { state.samples = []; state.sum = 0; } state.inPit = inPit; const now = Date.now(); if (!inPit && !$prop('DataCorePlugin.GamePaused') && !$prop('DataCorePlugin.GameData.NewData.IsGameReplay') && $prop('DataCorePlugin.GameData.NewData.SpeedKmh') > 5 && sample > 0) { state.samples.push([now, sample]); state.sum += sample; } const best = timespantoseconds($prop('DataCorePlugin.GameData.NewData.BestLapTime')); const last = timespantoseconds($prop('DataCorePlugin.GameData.NewData.LastLapTime')); const span = {{average_laps}} * (best > 0 ? best : last > 0 ? last : 120) * 1000; while (state.samples.length > 0 && now - state.samples[0][0] > span) { state.sum -= state.samples.shift()[1]; } return state.samples.length > 0 ? state.sum / state.samples.length : null;
